note: Floating screen: it is drawn through a portal into the page body and placed against the window, so the reference is the whole default 1280x800 window on the app's backdrop and every box is in window coordinates. The confirmation (stock-ui/confirm). Props are ConfirmProps; onConfirm and onCancel are no-ops. `via: close-guard` opens it the way the close warning of an agent's tab does (stock-ui/close-guard, which passes its own message, the Stop for everyone label and two extra rows as children); the other states are the dialog as other callers give it.
